newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - Dutch chartists neutral on AEX index.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dutch chartists neutral on AEX index.

text.p: Dutch chartists said on Monday the AEX index of leading shares was beginning to show some short-term wobbles but a break out of the current trading range either way has yet to be confirmed.
"We state that staying Neutral...is the best strategy on the short-term. For the scenarios on either side we advise to maintain close and trailing exit stops," ABN AMRO said.
"The momentum is showing divergence at very high levels and is still giving alarming signals," MeesPierson said.
The AEX index ended at 766.06 points on Friday, just up from 764.96 the previous Friday.
Contributor Trend Pvs view Support Resistance

ABN AMRO - Last week's correction has brought us to levels around 750 twice in a row. Now we can state the short-term support was set at 748. This coincides with short-term uptrend initiated late December. A renewed attack on this level is not excluded from the scenario we have in mind for the rest of the week. In case this short term bottom drops out of the market, 730 is the upper side of the medium term uptrend channel which can provide support for the bulls. On the other hand if 750 proves too strong to break in the correction, a renewed attack on 760 resistance is likely. In that case, we advise re-entering long positions for a serious attack on the previous top at 780.

ING BARINGS - The AEX, having successfully tested support at 750 in the past few days, is poised to retrace some lost ground. Resistance comes around 772 and then 780. The positive line of this money flow indicator was not dented in last week's turmoil. Strong money flow indicates liquidities keep pouring in on any price dip. The advance/decline ratio is topping a bit confirming present correction phase. Short term charts slightly improving but a close above 780 is required for the durable uptrend to resume. Longer term the rising trend channel remains intact, targetting 4-month levels around 825. A close below 735 needed to trigger a sell signal for a downside move towards 680.

RABO SECURITIES - We expect the AEX index to remain in a trading range between 747 and 779 this week. Abreak out of this range on the upside seems unlikely at the moment. A downward break (below 747) will trigger a further decline towards 733.

MEESPIERSON - The momentum is showing divergence at very high levels and is giving alarming signals. Tbhe blow off is still intact. Risks are on the downside. Trading range is expected to continue into this week.
